methods.summary: Returns an NFA with a single regex pattern that always matches at every position.

methods.summary: Get the byte classes for this NFA.

methods.name: compiler
methods.summary: Return a compiler for configuring the construction of an `NFA`.

methods.name: config
methods.summary: Return a default configuration for an `NFA`.

methods.name: group_info
methods.summary: Returns the capturing group info for this NFA.

methods.name: has_capture
methods.summary: Returns true if and only if this NFA has at least one [`Capture`](State::Capture) in its sequence of states.

methods.name: has_empty
methods.summary: Returns true if and only if this NFA can match the empty string. When it returns false, all possible matches are guaranteed to have a non-zero length.

methods.name: is_always_start_anchored
methods.summary: Returns true if and only if all starting states for this NFA correspond to the beginning of an anchored search.

methods.name: is_reverse
methods.summary: Returns true when this NFA is meant to be matched in reverse.

methods.name: is_utf8
methods.summary: Whether UTF-8 mode is enabled for this NFA or not.

methods.name: look_matcher
methods.summary: Returns the look-around matcher associated with this NFA.

methods.name: look_set_any
methods.summary: Returns the union of all look-around assertions used throughout this NFA. When the returned set is empty, it implies that the NFA has no look-around assertions and thus zero conditional epsilon transitions.

methods.name: look_set_prefix_any
methods.summary: Returns the union of all prefix look-around assertions for every pattern in this NFA. When the returned set is empty, it implies none of the patterns require moving through a conditional epsilon transition before inspecting the first byte…

methods.name: memory_usage
methods.summary: Returns the memory usage, in bytes, of this NFA.

methods.name: never_match
methods.summary: Returns an NFA that never matches at any position.

methods.name: new_many
methods.summary: Parse the given regular expressions using a default configuration and build a multi-NFA from them.

methods.name: pattern_len
methods.summary: Returns the total number of regex patterns in this NFA.

methods.name: patterns
methods.summary: Returns an iterator over all pattern identifiers in this NFA.

methods.name: start_anchored
methods.summary: Return the state identifier of the initial anchored state of this NFA.

methods.name: start_pattern
methods.summary: Return the state identifier of the initial anchored state for the given pattern, or `None` if there is no pattern corresponding to the given identifier.

methods.name: start_unanchored
